nodes.label: Punto Brand Mark (Upward Chevron)
nodes.rationale: The favicon is a rounded-square squircle on a pale blue field containing a bold blue upward chevron. It functions as the minimal, flat, border-based Punto brand mark: a simple upward angle suggesting growth, order, and a clear next action, rendered in the same royal blue family as the design system color-primary-500 (#2563EB). No text, no shadows, no gradients, matching the AGENTS.md brand personality of clarity, simplicity, and practical confidence rather than corporate or playful.
